label: SF Ref grammar: forms, 3CD clauses and ITR schedules
description_nl: An SF Ref is <form> <table> [#serial]: form 3CD, ITR3, ITR5 or ITR6; for 3CD the table is a clause 1-44 with its letters, e.g. 31(a); for an ITR the table is a schedule code from this list. Several are joined with ';'. 2026-10-11: ITR6 refs for a company (ITR6 BP profit, ITR6 DEP pm15, ITR6 MAT add_tax, ITR6 BS capital ...).
